To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a just in time compiler can be redesigned for a better balance between execution speed and compilation speed, and that a carefully selected subset of global optimizations can be integrated in such a compiler without a negative impact on compilation speed.

the client compiler is a good basis to experiment with new feedback directed just in time compiler techniques, and that a carefully selected subset of optimizations can be implemented efficiently and lead to better performance.

the client compiler is a good example of a just in time compiler for interactive applications, that the use of SSA and linear scan register allocation is a viable alternative for a client compiler, and that the Java HotSpot VM and the client are a good platform to experiment with new feedback directed optimization techniques.
In summary, our research is concerned with
optimizations that improve the performance of interactive desktop applications.
the development of a new just in time compiler for Java that focuses on low startup and pause time, but also delivers high performance.
the development of a fast and efficient client just in time compilation technology that is based on the latest research results in the field of compilation technology.

the new client compilation infrastructure is a solid base for future research in this area.
this paper presents the most important results of the last five years of just in time compiler research at Sun Microsystems.
the Java HotSpot VM is a good platform for research and experimentation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the new client VM architecture is a solid foundation for further research and development.
the client compiler is now a well engineered, fast and robust compiler that is able to generate code for a wide range of Java programs.
the Java HotSpot VM is a great research platform that is used by the research community and that is also the basis for the Java 6 client compiler that is now used by millions of users.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a just in time compiler does not have to be complex in order to generate high performance code for interactive desktop applications.
a well-designed just in time compiler can be fast, generate high quality code, and be integrated in a production level VM.
it is now feasible to integrate a large set of global optimizations into a Java just in time compilation system.
